step_by_step_reasoning: The video and diagram present the internal architecture of the AWS DeepRacer service. The system consists of the DeepRacer front-end/console interacting with services hosted inside a VPC (SageMaker and RoboMaker) and supporting external AWS storage and monitoring services (S3, Kinesis Video Streams, and CloudWatch). SageMaker manages the reinforcement learning model training (PPO algorithm), storing presets, environment parameters, and reward functions in S3. RoboMaker provides the simulation environment with physics fidelity, streams the first-person windshield video to Kinesis Video Streams, and sends logs/metrics regarding exploration vs. exploitation to CloudWatch.
